name: Axe Kick (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Tae Kwon Do, Dex 13, Acrobatics 1 rank or BAB +1

Benefit(s): When using this style, you gain double the normal bonus on damage rolls from this style’s feats when you make a single attack as a standard action.
